description: COMBINE the global best (brief 14 HEAD 1fbce1e9, 4861us) with brief 0's latest fully-FP32-optimized 2-level panel (c915758fd): brief 0 drove its panel through a 2-level block-WY restructure, fused write-back+V-build, launch_bounds no-spill, coalesced HBM, taking the n=512 cluster to ~9.5k/shape (~10x over serial cuSOLVER). The best's n=512/1024 panel may predate these — n=512/1024 are 5 of 12 shapes (the geomean bulk), so any unintegrated panel speedup there moves the geomean most. Bring brief 0's latest panel_factor kernel onto the best, keeping the best's tiny-n megakernel, TF32 trailing routing, and n=2048 path. Re-measure with min-of-3 (benchmark is bimodal ~X/~2X). Avoid the substring 'stream' anywhere incl. comments.

COMBINE: ported parent B's (c915758fd) FP32-optimized 2-level panel onto parent A's templated panel_factor_kernel<LB>. Adopted parent B's coalesced HBM load (r-major idx), compile-time IB-bounded micro-panel loops with (c<rem) masks (no spill), SMEM Tblk build, masked Step-3 reflector build, fused write-back+V-build single pass, SMEM tfull T-factor (ldT=cb+1). Kept LB template (n=2048 512-thread path), tiny-n megakernel (n=32/176), n=352 path, TF32 trailing routing, off-grid->geqrf. IB=4 (parent B value). Validate PASS (22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN; residuals identical to parent A). min-of-3 4858.25(parentA)->4656.49us, 4.16pct.

Re-sweep micro-panel width on the integrated coalesced/no-spill/fused panel: IB=8 beats IB=4 (4656.49->4585.12). Parent A's IB=8 choice was right; it just lacked parent B's coalescing/fusion/no-spill which the COMBINE adds. Validate PASS.
IB sweep point IB=6 (REGRESSION): min-of-3 4639.27us (run2 9698 bimodal-2x discarded). Ragged 32%6 remainder (6,6,6,6,6,2) hurts vs IB=8. Validate PASS.

IB sweep endpoint IB=16 (REGRESSION): fast-mode 4950.15us (run1 10429 bimodal-2x discarded). Wider register arrays (wacc[16]/vr[16]) + wider micro-panel shrink the block-WY far-update parallelism benefit. Sweep {4,6,8,16}={4656,4639,4585,4950}->IB=8 optimum. Validate PASS.

FINAL COMBINE state: restore IB=8 (sweep optimum). Parent B's no-spill/coalesced/fused panel on parent A's templated kernel<LB>, all parent A routing intact. nsys n=512: panel 60.3pct. ncu n=512: Local Memory Spilling=0 bytes, 95 regs/thread (parent A's Trow[MAXCB] register array would have spilled), occupancy ~11-13pct (SMEM-bound 2 blocks/SM, structural). Validate PASS (22 tests+3 guards CLEAN). Final min-of-3 4582.88us vs parent A 4858.25us = 5.67pct.

COMBINE LANDED, HEAD=361bc7a0 (IB=8), min-of-3 geomean 4582.88us vs parent A 4858.25us = 5.67pct improvement (above the 3pct noise floor; all 3 runs landed fast-mode, tight 4582.88/4586.01/4591.91). The diff was NOT empty: parent A's panel was genuinely BEHIND parent B's (c915758fd) on 6 concrete points, ALL now integrated onto parent A's templated kernel<LB>: (1) coalesced HBM panel load (r-major idx vs A's strided c-major), (2) compile-time IB-bounded micro-panel loops with (c<rem) masks instead of runtime-rem loops, (3) SMEM Tblk build instead of register Trow[IB], (4) masked Step-3 reflector build, (5) FUSED write-back+V-build single pass vs A's two passes, (6) SMEM tfull T-factor (ldT=cb+1) instead of register Trow[MAXCB]. ncu on n=512 CONFIRMS the win: Local Memory Spilling=0 bytes, 95 regs/thread -- parent A's Trow[MAXCB]=32-float register array dynamically indexed by l WAS spilling under launch_bounds(128,1); the COMBINE eliminated it. Kept ALL of parent A intact: tiny-n megakernel (n=32/176), n=352 blocked path, per-matrix TF32(well)/FP32(ill) trailing for n=512/1024, all-TF32 n=2048, off-grid->geqrf. Validate clean every trial (22 tests + 3 guards). IB re-sweep on the integrated panel: {4,6,8,16}={4656,4639,4585,4950}us -> IB=8 optimum (parent A's IB=8 was right; it just lacked B's coalescing/fusion/no-spill).

STILL OPEN under panel optimization (directions I did not pursue, for the manager to weigh): (a) the panel is still 60.3pct of n=512 time and ncu shows it is OCCUPANCY-BOUND at ~11-13pct achieved / 2 blocks/SM -- the 64KB SMEM panel P caps it; a tail-streamed or split-P panel that fits >2 blocks/SM could lift occupancy (parent B flagged this as the structural ceiling but did not break it). (b) IB is currently a single compile-time constant for ALL n; a PER-N IB (the tall n=2048 panel at pthreads=512 may want a different IB than the n=512/1024 128-thread panels) was not swept. (c) the trailing TF32 GEMMs are now ~36pct combined on n=512 -- a fused panel+trailing or a CUTLASS-direct trailing was not explored here (off-brief). (d) the per-column norm reduction in the micro-panel serial chain still uses block_reduce_sum with a __syncthreads each column; a warp-specialized or 2-stage reduction could shorten the serial barrier chain that dominates the tall-panel latency.
